title: Recover without duplicating the request
when: A message is undelivered, parked or collapsed into an earlier message
need: Inspect message/attempt state and the earlier message when collapsed. No steering seat means parked for a successor. A turn ending sends no Fleet message. Cancellation and acknowledgement are separate explicit operations. Stale running recipients without an idle route use stopped-session resume automatically; inspect the original receipt and wake attempts before retrying. Steering reports automatically flag unresolved pending/injected receipts on ended sessions without remaining routes, using message visibility and confirmed item scope. Read and handle or re-address the work, then sender actor or target-project admin may cancel obsolete mail; report reads never settle receipts or replay QA.
surface: Message receipt/output -> get; Items and Sessions recovery examples.
review: Candidate source tests prove every declared surface delivers at its hook, intentional operator waits remain uncharged, exhausted native routes notify the covering steering seat, and verified containment releases matching pending holds. Candidate recovery preserves process start-time evidence, supersedes old holds after a later delivered wake, and dates Fleet silence observations. Live release proof remains pending. Ended-session report composition is covered by disposable fixture regressions; deployed candidate proof remains pending. Narrow recipient reads exclude unrelated session history; duplicate failure notices check their durable identity before resolving recipients. Survey recovery retains the accepted write and rechecks live conflicts over eligible items.
